title: Hausdorff integrals over the image of a measurable set under an affine isometry ℝ^m → ℝ^P (parent Part E)
statement: Let m, P ∈ ℕ, let ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^P be a linear isometry (ℝ^d = Euclid d), c ∈ ℝ^P, G(w) := ιw + c, and let A ⊆ ℝ^m be measurable. Then G(A) is a (Borel) measurable subset of ℝ^P, and for every function f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{G(A)} f dH^m = ∫_A f(G(w)) dw, where H^m = μHE[m] (Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure) on ℝ^P and dw is Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝ^m; both sides are Bochner integrals (a non-integrable function has integral 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (c : Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid m)), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet ((fun w => ι w + c) '' A) ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ y in (fun w => ι w + c) '' A, f y ∂μHE[m] = ∫ w in A, f (ι w + c)
